evidence: Every gating file parses with zero errors (frozen task under .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r8/task). Python 3.12 tomllib loads task.toml, which has the keys schema_version/artifacts/task/metadata/agent/environment/verifier, and tests/scoring.toml, which has the keys gates/weights/floors. It also loads all five judge.toml files. rewardkit 0.1.7's own runner.discover(), run in the existing cw-editor-verifier:current image (pinned harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7) with /tests mounted read-only and --network none, builds every suite without error. It returns gates: constraints and render as AgentJudge, batched, 600 s, 1 criterion each, with playwright. It returns scored: functional as AgentJudge, individual, 550 s, 16 criteria, with playwright+verifier MCP; polish as batched, 900 s, 6 criteria; and visual as batched, 900 s, 4 criteria. Each prompt.md contains the {criteria} and {app_context} placeholders. Shell scripts: bash -n passes for tests/test.sh and solution/solve.sh, and for the app-restart.sh heredoc extracted from test.sh lines 127-185. Both have a #!/bin/bash shebang, and a byte scan of the whole task tree finds no CR byte. tests/test.sh, tests/Dockerfile and tests/tools/{score.py,restart_mcp.py} are byte-identical to the frozen template, and both .py files parse with ast. Seeds: environment/assets/seed_data.json and solution/app/seed/seed_data.json parse as JSON and are identical (sha b256f85e...). package.json parses, with start='node server.js'. Reference entry: node --check passes for server.js and public/app.js. server.js listens on PORT (default 3000) and honours DB_PATH, which matches test.sh lines 68/97-111 (requires /app/server.js and launches it with node on port 3000) and instruction.md ('starting from /app/server.js ... /app/app.db'). Runtime: the raw-evidence-index hashes and all 9 matching_source_files hashes match the frozen bytes. golden-run.log shows the frozen solve.sh install booted ('Kittle & Rowe matter chat on port 3000', twice across the real restart), with all 16 functional + gate_constraints + 6 polish scripted checks PASS. Risk=true because the 'would run' half is not fully measured on these bytes. No full configured verifier/judge run exists for this candidate, and the index says so. Hosted Oracle 0.9917 is for the previous v2 bytes. functional judge.toml lines 7-11 say the new individual-mode 16x550 s budget is 'Not yet measured against a judge run'. That is not a parse defect, but the missing runtime evidence remains open.
